scope: Read-only audit of five completed 60-update runs; no NPU calls, no source snapshots changed. Combined runs excluded while pending.

baseline_repeat_fairness.interpretation: Review settings and source differences before attributing speed changes to a single feature. Completion and finite metrics are prerequisite checks; numerical equivalence has no automatic tolerance-based verdict here.

baseline_control_interpretation: 两次基线训练源码哈希一致；清单差异只有已识别编译产物 fusion_result.json 与 kernel_meta/buildPidInfo.json。配置除输出目录外相同，数据列表哈希、数据来源元信息与学习率曲线一致。
两次基线前两步 loss、grad_norm 完全相同，从第3步开始均出现分歧。重复基线 wall 每步快约2.86%，证明短跑存在自然运行差异；两次样本不足以建立稳定方差或显著性阈值。
原基线清单未显式记录所有后来新增开关，但相同 baseline 源码在 NPU 上固定 foreach=False；有效 YAML 均为 gradient_checkpointing=True。外部权重、完整数据与逐批输入仍无完整哈希，不能声称逐位相同。
recommended_conclusions: 使用更快重复基线，monitor 的壁钟收益只有1.76%，attention只有1.18%；对原较慢基线分别4.57%与4.00%。这两个单项的速度收益弱，不能把更大原始百分比当成稳定保障，也不能叠加百分比预测组合。
attention 的 rank-0 peak allocated 从53.31降至46.68GiB，节省6.63GiB（约12.44%）；此容量收益是保留它并试验减少重计算的主要依据。仍不是所有rank峰值或reserved显存。
foreach 对较快重复基线壁钟省12.35%，对原基线省14.86%；超过目前两次基线之间的2.86%漂移，是当前单项最可信的速度收益，但60步顺序短跑不等于长时间稳定提速保证。
基线重复自己的loss最大绝对差0.001220703125、gradnorm最大相对差5.8157%（step30）。monitor对原基线10.4982%的gradnorm差，换重复基线为4.9716%；attention与foreach对重复基线最大gradnorm相对差约4.7452%与3.8149%。说明数值分歧并非候选独有，但不能证明候选完全无误。
所有已完成单项和控制组均60步、exit0且记录指标有限；LR与expertLR逐步相同。继续组合试验合理，结论限于短程数值稳定；标量loss及梯度范数不足以证明完整梯度相等或任务效果不下降。

source_manifest_classification_fix.reason: Root fusion_result.json is observed NPU compiler output; arbitrary JSON files and nested same-name files remain nonruntime.

limitations: Speed windows exclude initialization; 13..60 wall uses timestamp step12 to step60, 48 updates. Whole-second logs yield <1 second interval quantization, or <0.02084 s/update.
Two repeated controls constrain interpretation but are not a confidence interval; sequential run order, device/host load and runtime cache state remain possible confounders.
Resource samples are sequential queries grouped by last_step and may cross update boundaries; they do not support precise MFU or synchronized all-card utilization claims.
Observed scalar differences do not identify the nondeterministic kernel. Index accumulation, grouped-matmul reductions, collectives and router ties are hypotheses, not verified causes.
No long-run convergence or robot success-rate evaluation is included.
